title: Human Body Learning & Personal Safety
core_safety_message: Our bodies belong to us. We care for our health, and we speak to a trusted adult if anything ever feels unsafe.

parts.name: Head
parts.function: Holds our brain which thinks, dreams, and learns.

parts.name: Eyes
parts.function: Allow us to see colors, books, shapes, and smiles.

parts.name: Ears
parts.function: Help us hear music, bird songs, and words.

parts.name: Nose
parts.function: Breathes fresh air and smells delicious food.

parts.name: Mouth
parts.function: Helps us speak kind words, smile, and eat healthy meals.

parts.name: Hands
parts.function: Wave hello, draw art, write, and hold loved ones.

parts.name: Arms
parts.function: Help us reach, carry school bags, and give warm hugs.

parts.name: Legs
parts.function: Help us walk, jump, climb stairs, and dance.

parts.name: Feet
parts.function: Keep us balanced on the ground as we stand and walk.

parts.name: Fingers
parts.function: Turn book pages and type on computer keyboards.

parts.name: Toes
parts.function: Help us stay steady when we run and walk.

parts.name: Shoulders
parts.function: Connect our arms to our body and help us stretch.

parts.name: Knees
parts.function: Bend smoothly so we can sit down and stand up.

parts.name: Elbows
parts.function: Bend our arms so we can drink water and eat.
